text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
As the public mock race enters its final stretch,
many Umamusume have begun their final spurts one after another!
Who will claim victory before the gathered fans!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I won't... let you!
Like I'd let you get away! Nuwoooo—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe A
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-saaaan!! Go for ittttt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Ha!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh! Don't panic, Yaeno Muteki!
My time to make a move is—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Right here!
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she faltered slightly at times,
after a hard-fought battle, Yaeno Muteki seized the victory.
choice_data_list: Good work today, and congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No...
I am hardly worthy
of such high praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Looking solely at the result, it is indeed a victory.
...However, I found myself tossed about by the raging fire within.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is solely due to the immaturity of my own heart...!
Kh...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe A
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the public mock race—
I received a sudden invitation from the "Yaeno Muteki Troupe."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for cheering me on the other day as well.
...So, what was it you needed from me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted to give you this present in person.
Here you are, this obi sash.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, this embroidery.
Does it mean "Invincible Power"?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If our cheering could become even a little bit of strength for Yaeno Muteki!
That's what I thought after watching Yaeno-san the other day!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe C
text_block_list.text:
The whole troupe stitched this together, stitch by stitch!
Please, accept it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (The "power of Yaeno Muteki"...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe A
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-saaaan!! Go for ittttt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "The reason for my victory in the recent race was none other than all of you, the 'Yaeno Muteki Fan Club.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch, I reacted to the fighting spirit around me
and almost mistimed my move.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, what calmed my anxious heart
were the cheers from everyone that reached my ears at that moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, everyone has already become my strength—
the 'strength of Yaeno Muteki.'
And not just a little, but immensely so.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I would like to take this occasion to express my gratitude once more.
Thank you so much for your continuous, heartfelt support!
choice_data_list: Let me thank you as well!
Please allow me to thank you as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki Troupe Members
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san, Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, that doesn't change the fact
that I am still inexperienced.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So that I may reach even greater heights,
I humbly accept this belt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, when Yaeno Muteki showed up for training,
on her arm was—
choice_data_list: You came wrapped up like a present, huh?
You came with a wrapped present, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
To strive for literal "invincible power."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: They say a name reflects one's nature, so I want to devote myself to training while mindful of the weight of those words.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Heart' of the fans dwelling in this obi,
and the 'Technique' learned from Trainer-dono—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall house both of them within my 'body.'
That is to say, inseparable as one!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then it shall become an 'invincible power'
that yields neither to others nor to oneself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Yaeno Muteki spoke with such conviction, her eyes
blazed with an extraordinary desire to improve.
choice_data_list: Then we've got to train you thoroughly!
Then we've got to train you thoroughly!
Let's do our best together! Oss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Yaeno Muteki spoke with such conviction, her eyes
blazed with an extraordinary desire to improve.
choice_data_list: Then we've got to train you thoroughly!
Then we've got to train you thoroughly!
Let's do our best together! Oss!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I intend to forge myself anew from square one!
So please, don't hold back at all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! I look forward to your guidance and instruction, greater now than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I truly believe that together with you, Trainer-dono,
we will surely reach that peak!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: OSSUUU!!!
